verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document proactive alerts that tell a founder when a new hire, a new work location, or a law change creates a compliance obligation. Nearby features fall short of the story. Automatically delivered updated labor law posters cover posting rules, not obligation alerts. AI error flagging targets payroll mistakes, and multi-state tax filing is done on the user's behalf without any alerting.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get proactive alerts when a new hire, location, or law change creates a compliance obligation
